name: WIOCC/OADC Abia State Broadband Connectivity and Data Centers
developer: WIOCC Group / Open Access Data Centres with Abia State Government
notes: Abia State signed an MoU with WIOCC Group for statewide broadband connectivity and data centers, with fiber focus on Aba, Umuahia and Ohafia and an Atlantic termination hub at Owaza River. No site-level capacity figure found; later coverage describes a WIOCC duct infrastructure groundbreaking in Aba and cites OADC leadership involvement.

name: Adamawa Government-led Durable Solutions Data Centre
notes: Adamawa State opened a government-led data centre in Yola for durable-solutions/displacement data, supported by IOM. Humanitarian/public-sector data centre rather than commercial colocation; capacity not disclosed.

name: Kasi Cloud DNEK Campus
notes: Kasi Cloud's own data-centers page lists a coming-soon DNEK Campus in Eket, Akwa Ibom, with DNEK1 and DNEK2. DCD also reported Kasi is developing another data center in Eket but that few details are public. Capacity not disclosed for DNEK.

name: Anambra State Data Centre
developer: Anambra State Government / Anambra State ICT Agency
notes: Public tender notice sought hardware components for setup of the Anambra State Data Centre, and Anambra State Government material later referenced ongoing strategic planning for the data centre. No public capacity or commissioning confirmation found.

name: Galaxy Backbone-Bauchi Hosted ICT/Data Centre Services Partnership
developer: Galaxy Backbone Limited / Bauchi State Government
notes: MoU covers digital infrastructure and ICT services across Bauchi State, leveraging Galaxy Backbone data centre facilities in Abuja and Kano. Sources do not confirm a new physical Bauchi data centre build, so this is recorded as a hosted/services partnership tied to the division.

name: BDIC / UniCloud Africa Makurdi Tier III Data Centre
developer: Benue Digital Infrastructure Company, UniCloud Africa, Africa Data Centres and partners
notes: MoU calls for a state-owned data center and cloud ecosystem in Makurdi, with Africa Data Centres providing a disaster recovery site in Abuja. DCD reported estimated project cost of NGN 10.8 billion and six-month completion target; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: Borno State Data Center / Borno Data Centre
developer: Borno State Government with eHealth Africa and World Bank support
notes: World Bank implementation reporting for the Borno financial/data-management project tracked modern ICT equipment supplied and operational at the Borno State Data Center. eHealth Africa project material describes furniture, IT equipment setup and staff training for the Borno Data Center serving state reconstruction and humanitarian/development partners.

name: Bayelsa State ICT Village Secure Data Center
developer: Bayelsa State Ministry of Communication, Science and Technology
notes: Bayelsa State ministry release says the ICT Village is equipped with high-speed internet, solar-powered energy grid and a secure data center to support startups and digital entrepreneurs. Capacity not disclosed.

name: NRG Bloom 5MW Flare Gas-Powered Data Center
notes: Operator-linked social post describes a 5MW flare-gas-powered data center in the Bayelsa creeks used for off-grid Bitcoin mining, with visitors traveling via Yenagoa. Exact location and commissioning documentation not independently verified.

name: Nugi Group Tier 4 Data Centre, Calabar
notes: Nugi Group announced plans for a Tier 4 data centre in Calabar, Cross River State, reportedly on land near a waterfall and intended to use hydro, solar and natural gas power sources. Capacity not disclosed.

name: 9mobile Proposed Cross River State Government Data Centre
notes: 9mobile proposed a partnership with Cross River State to build a data centre for hosting government data and digitising administrative processes. DCD notes the project depended on state acceptance; no capacity or later delivery confirmation found.

name: Delta State Command Data Center and Investigation Room
developer: Delta State Government / Delta State Police Command / First Rhema Solutions
notes: Delta security digitisation coverage and social posts describe commissioning of a modern Data Center and Investigation Room in Asaba for the Delta State Command. Appears to be a public-security/command facility rather than commercial colocation; capacity not disclosed.
